description: Create a full backup of a specific instance (by id or exact name), covering everything in its file area. Worth doing before any risky change, since restoring later replaces the whole file area. The backup is built on the game node and appears in list_backups once it finishes, which can take several minutes for a large server. If this instance's backup storage is already full, creating another automatically deletes the oldest unlocked backups, so this asks for confirmation first.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set this only after showing the user exactly what will be deleted, when this instance's backup storage is full and older backups have to make room and getting their approval.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

name: create_backup
title: Create Backup
